meta.title: A vendor cannot read an unpublished (draft) stage

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an RFQ (pricing) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer sends the request that reads the round, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to view this event.”, and never with a server error.
